'''Pecan''' is one of the many genera of [[tree]]s found [[above ground]]. Like the vast majority of above ground trees, pecan [[wood]] is brown and produces brown products.

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] pecan trees for their ''nuts''.
